name: sc5_wallx
goal: Scenario 5, human interference: harness reads the label -> zone + arm -> WALLX prompt; WALLX picks + places (90 calls, re-planning from the head camera every call); a person moves the parcel mid-grasp and WALLX goes after it again.
setup: IQBAR box (label LL-11, pincode 90024 -> zone 2) standing sideways in the middle of the table, label up; arms at rest. A person moves the box once while WALLX reaches for it.
prompt: Use the {arm} arm to grab the IQBAR box from the top or the sides, never front to back, pick it up from the middle of the table, stretch and put it into zone {zone}.
